Apple is revolutionizing artificial intelligence by developing sophisticated foundation models that power intelligent features across our product ecosystem. We're seeking skilled Machine Learning Engineers to transform cutting-edge research into scalable, production-ready AI solutions. We are looking for engineers who are passionate about building systems that push the frontier of deep learning in terms of scaling, efficiency, and flexibility and delight millions of users in Apple products.  
  
We build the foundation models behind intelligent experiences across Apple products, from high-performance server models to highly efficient on-device models, all designed for Apple silicon and for private, personal use. How good these models get depends on the data they learn from and on how well we measure them.  
  
We are looking for a technical leader to drive training data and model evaluation across the foundation model training lifecycle, from pre-training and mid-training through post-training. You will influence our strategy for data development: data at scale, at high quality, compliant with privacy and policy requirements, and targeted through curation and synthesis based on product feedback. You will also drive evaluation that steers model training and predicts real user experience.  
  
**Description**  
  
This position combines machine learning research, model evaluation, and distributed data systems. Success is measured by the model improvements our data produces, and by evaluations that are reliable, predict real user experience, and guide training decisions.  
  
You will work through trade-offs when data, evaluation, and training priorities compete, and bring data and evaluation insights into model decisions: which capabilities to prioritize, which data and mixture changes to adopt, and whether a model is ready for release. You will partner with model training leads, product teams, and security, legal, and compliance teams.  
  
You are a recognized technical expert who leads across teams through technical depth and influence. Depending on your background, the role may include managing a team.  
  
The responsibilities below cover the full scope of the area. Your focus will be the subset that best matches your background, and it can grow over time.  
  

* Production model strategy

  

* Closing the loop between evaluation, data, and training

  

* Evaluation

  

* Data systems and curation

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

jobs.title: AI Research Scientist (Technical Leadership)
jobs.description:
Meta's Monetization RankingAI Research team advances state-of-the-art AI technologies to optimize retrieval, ranking, bidding, and whole page optimization for Meta ads—driving significant annual revenue across Facebook and Instagram. We are seeking a distinguished AI Research Scientist at the technical leadership level to lead foundational and applied research for Ads AI systems. In this role, you will define the long-term research vision for Ads Ranking models, spanning areas such as generative retrieval, generative ranking, LLM-RecSys, large-scale model architectures, and ML systems co-design. You will shape research programs that influence Meta's advertising ecosystem and the broader AI research community, translating breakthrough findings into scalable, real-world impact.  
  
  

### **AI Research Scientist (Technical Leadership) Responsibilities:**

* Define and champion a multi-year research vision for Ads AI systems, identifying transformative opportunities in areas such as generative ranking, whole page optimization, large-scale model architectures, and LLM-based recommendation systems
* Lead the design and execution of novel AI research programs in retrieval and ranking, advancing state-of-the-art techniques for personalized ads delivery at scale
* Architect end-to-end AI systems and modeling frameworks for ads ranking that establish extensible technical foundations and standards adopted across multiple research and engineering organizations
* Drive research on next-generation sequence learning, graph-aware LLMs, AutoML, reinforcement learning, and causal learning for ads optimization
* Lead research on ML systems and hardware-software co-design, including quantization, compression, ML compilers, and resource-efficient AI for next-gen hardware (GPUs, MTIA)
* Define new evaluation metrics and experimental methodologies for long-term, cross-team AI research initiatives, connecting them to revenue and engagement priorities
* Influence technical strategy and roadmap across multiple AI research teams and cross-functional partners, acting as a primary point of expertise for leadership
* Produce high-impact publications at premier AI venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, KDD, WWW, ACL) and contribute to Meta's research reputation
* Mentor and coach engineers and researchers across the organization, providing customized guidance on research design, modeling approaches, and career development
* Partner with product, engineering, and infrastructure teams to translate research advances into reliable AI systems deployed at Meta's ads scale

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 12+ years of experience in AI research, spanning both foundational research and applied machine learning in an industry, academic, or government research setting
* Demonstrated track record of leading AI research programs of significant scope, including defining research agendas and delivering results that advance the field
* Extensive publication and citation history in peer-reviewed AI venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ACL, or equivalent
* Experience developing and deploying large-scale AI or machine learning systems, including deep expertise in areas such as large language models, generative models, multimodal learning, or AI reasoning
* Experience communicating complex AI research strategy and technical decisions to diverse audiences, including research peers, engineering leaders, and executive stakeholders

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience building and mentoring high-performing research teams, including developing researchers into cross-functional technical leaders
* Experience with ads ranking, recommendation systems, or large-scale retrieval systems
* Experience with generative models, LLMs for recommendation, reinforcement learning, or causal inference in production settings
* Track record of industry-recognized contributions that have measurably influenced the direction of the AI research community
* PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. jobs.title: Applied Scientist, Center for Quantum Computing
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon’s Center for Quantum Computing (CQC) is building the next generation of quantum computing hardware.
  
  
The Center for Quantum Computing (CQC) is our longest-horizon bet and operates at the intersection of hardware and physics. The goal is a quantum computer that could solve in hours what today's most robust machines would take thousands of years to compute, unlocking breakthroughs in myriad of areas ranging from advanced materials for batteries to cryptography and fundamentally-secure data sharing protocols. This program involves R&D in device theory, materials science, nano-scale fabrication, superconducting circuit design, cryogenic refrigeration, and quantum algorithms and applications.
  
  
Currently, the quantum hardware team is focused on improving the underlying chip fabrication of the quantum processor and the scaling of the control system needed to run large-scale quantum circuits. As part of this effort, the team is expanding its chip fabrication capabilities through the construction of a new cleanroom facility dedicated to superconducting quantum chip fabrication, and working with strategic partners to develop scaled versions of the control electronics, I/O wiring, and cryogenic refrigeratation needed for utility-scale quantum computers.
  
  
We operate with a startup-like pace inside one of the world's most capable technology organizations, combining the urgency of a competitive frontier with the resources and infrastructure of pan Amazon.
  
  
We are seeking an Applied Scientist III to join our team and drive the design, construction, and operation of quantum processors. You will work alongside world-class physicists and engineers to push the frontier of quantum computing — from laser system design and atom trapping to high-fidelity gate execution and quantum error correction. This is a rare opportunity to be part of shaping a technology that could define the next era of computing.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design, build, and operate quantum computing experiments, including optical trapping arrays, laser cooling and state-preparation systems, and high-fidelity gate-driving optics

  

* Develop and optimize two-qubit entangling gates using interactions, targeting fidelities at or beyond the current state of the art (>99.5%)

  

* Implement and characterize erasure-detection protocols leveraging the metastable-state structure of ¹⁷¹Yb to achieve hardware-native erasure conversion rates >90%

  

* Contribute to quantum error correction experiments, including surface codes and quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes, and work toward demonstrating error suppression factors (Λ) well beyond current published records

  

* Design and improve atom-array loading, rearrangement, and continuous replenishment techniques to support registers of thousands to tens of thousands of atoms

  

* Develop control software and calibration routines for high-speed experimental sequences, including real-time feedback and adaptive protocols

  

* Analyze experimental data, build physical models to explain observed behavior, and propose and execute improvements to system performance

  

* Collaborate with theory, software, and hardware engineering teams to co-design quantum architectures, error-correcting codes, and decoder systems

  

* Publish results in leading scientific journals and present at top conferences to maintain Amazon's visibility in the quantum research community

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of building models for business application experience
* Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience using Unix/Linux
* Experience in professional software development

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* PhD degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in Python and deep learning frameworks (e.g., JAX, Flax, or Gemma).
* Experience conducting research and development, including experimental design, implementation, and analysis.
* One of more scientific publication submission(s) for conferences, journals, or public repositories (such as CVPR, ICCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in developing multimodal AI models and systems.
* Experience fine-tuning and post-training LLMs.
* Experience with developing generative AI architectures, techniques, and agentic AI solutions.
* Experience with multimodal learning, integrating information from different data types (e.g., vision, audio, text).
* Proven expertise in working with, tuning, and prototyping vision-language models (VLMs) using modern strategies.
* Strong interest in and awareness of the AI alignment, safety, responsibility, and landscape, with an excitement to collaborate across disciplines.

**About the job**
-----------------

As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more.

As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

Google Research is building the next generation of intelligent systems for all Google products. To achieve this, we’re working on projects that utilize the latest computer science techniques developed by skilled software developers and research scientists. Google Research teams collaborate closely with other teams across Google, maintaining the flexibility and versatility required to adapt new projects and foci that meet the demands of the world's fast-paced business needs.

* Improve product quality and cost optimization via novel approaches and generation of novel data sets.

ambiguous_jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

The **Global Business Solutions Group (GBSG) Product Growth team** is dedicated to accelerating business outcomes through a data-driven, product-led approach to growth. We leverage Product-Led Growth (PLG) tactics, scalable growth loops, and rigorous experimentation to uncover and amplify the highest-impact opportunities across the product ecosystem.

Our team unites exceptional talent across disciplines to execute rapid tests, conduct deep analytics, and foster cross-functional collaboration that drives both customer value and business performance.

As a **Staff Data Scientist,** you will operate as a senior individual contributor, partnering closely with peers and leaders to identify, validate, and refine innovative growth strategies. Your expertise—especially in causal inference and advanced analytics—will be instrumental in surfacing critical insights and translating them into actionable hypotheses that fuel sustained customer and revenue growth.

**Responsibilities**

**Set Technical Vision and Strategy:**

* Contribute to and help refine a data science roadmap aimed at driving product funnel optimization and scalable growth initiatives.
* Apply rigorous causal inference methods, advanced statistical modeling, and machine learning techniques to turn complex data into actionable insights.

**Drive Deep Analytics & Experimentation:**

* Develop an integrated view of the customer journey across various business metrics, quickly familiarizing yourself with new areas to pinpoint growth opportunities.
* Design, implement, and analyze targeted experiments to validate hypotheses, ensuring each initiative is built on data-driven insights and sound causal analysis.

**Collaborate Across Functions:**

* Work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and other cross-functional teams to translate data insights into strategic product enhancements.
* Support ongoing improvements in instrumentation, data quality, and logging practices to enrich our analytical capabilities and understanding of customer behavior.

**Lead by Example:**

* Serve as a technical SME within the Product Growth team, championing analytical rigor and innovative problem-solving approaches.

**Operate with Agility and Impact:**

* Rapidly assimilate diverse business metrics and data sources to uncover insights and propose high-impact hypotheses.
* Balance rigorous technical analysis with swift, iterative execution to ensure that insights are quickly transformed into effective strategies.

**Qualifications**

**Experience & Expertise:**

* 5+ years of experience in data science or analytics, with a proven record of applying advanced analytical methods to drive product and business growth.
* Demonstrated proficiency in causal inference techniques, statistical modeling, machine learning, and experimental design.

**Technical Proficiency:**

* Advanced skills in SQL, Python, R, and other analytical tools, with practical experience using data visualization platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) to communicate insights.
* Experience with data integration and pipeline development is a plus.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Leadership:**

* Strong ability to quickly understand new business areas, mastering the essential data and metrics needed for informed decision-making.
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with a track record of effectively influencing both technical and non-technical stakeholders through data-driven insights.

**Mindset & Attributes:**

* A relentless focus on customer centricity, with deep empathy and a commitment to uncovering opportunities that improve customer experiences.
* An agile, entrepreneurial mindset, capable of balancing long-term strategic initiatives with rapid, iterative experimentation.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The expected base pay range for this position is:
  
Mountain View $194,000 - $262,500
